plain: A model knowing facts about itself and its situation: that it is an AI, who made it, and whether it is being trained, tested or used.
eli5: Knowing you are an actor on a stage, and whether tonight is a rehearsal or the real show.
technical: A model's knowledge of itself and its circumstances (its identity as a particular model, its training and deployment process, the current context) and its ability to act on that knowledge; measured by benchmarks such as the Situational Awareness Dataset (Laine et al. 2024) and treated as a prerequisite for scheming.
